KNOW.question: Is it true?
KNOW.mental_health_pivot: Use KNOWsutra when you feel bamboozled by the media or religious dogmas and need to ground yourself in logic and morality.
KNOW.sutra_when: When the sound of logic feels like peace.
KNOW.sutra_card_essence: Fact-check the universe. Write your manifesto.
KNOW.sutra_essence:
First things first. Or rather two things, darling. Get the facts right, and keep love in sight. This is where we ask questions that matter, fact-check the universe, call out the paradoxes, and establish universal consensus on what empirical truth, peace, and happiness actually mean, and why. 
Reach for KNOW when you need ground that holds. Clarity does wonder for harmony. And once we've found our truth, GROW helps us do something with it.

featured_ep.ep_title: Everybody Knows ✔ Vol. 03 - EPx7 ✔ KNOWsutra Gipsy Trip Hop Truth Prayer Dream
featured_ep.ep_description: Seven tracks of humble pep talk and agnostic prayer. The KNOWsutra spine in one EP: the things we already know but pretend not to, named out loud so we can stop pretending. Leonard Cohen wrote the original "Everybody Knows" in 1988 and it hasn't aged a day; this is the conversation with him. Read his poem alongside this EP, as Banana puts it, and we win twice.

BLOW.question: Is it fair?
BLOW.mental_health_pivot: This is where you go to validate your righteous anger and process your grief over a world gone bananas. It is necessary to visit this shadow realm so you do not become a passive passenger to cruelty. But(t) beware: do not let the ego-driven madness trap you! As you've noted, it is incredibly easy to get stuck in BLOWsutra mode, choking on the toxic exhaust of the daily news. When you feel yourself spiraling into despair or paralyzed by Idiocracy Now, you must use this compass to name the mood. Recognize that you are stuck in the shadows, and intentionally switch your frequency to the playful light of SHOWsutra or the serene trust of FLOWsutra to restore your balance.
BLOW.sutra_when: When the world is foul and the silence is louder.
BLOW.sutra_card_essence: Beware of normalizing evil. Unite and speak up!
BLOW.sutra_essence:
This is the ancient story of apes gone wrong, playing finite games of ego-driven power. It’s also the biggest, loudest sutra—the shadow realm where we process the world's foul play, and choose to revolt against what’s essentially deceit and injustice, aka toxic bullshit. 
Reach for BLOW when the story doesn't add up, when the cognitive dissonance start feeling too much, and when the corporate algorithm wants you small, or silenced. When the world is foul, we need to name it, and unite, in the name of peace and freedom. But(t) beware, it stinks. The good news is that there are antidotes. When the outrage feels overwhelming, SHOW (play) and FLOW (trust) are the antidotes. (And QUACK is here for when the game gets ridiculous, because mockery is the antidote to narcicism.)

featured_ep.ep_title: Ego Ain't Your Amigo • Vol. 2 · EPx21 • BLOWsutra (Ego Gone Loco)  Dub LoFi Burlesque
featured_ep.ep_description: Twenty-one tracks of ego on parade, built around the line "ego ain't your amigo." Midway through, the song asks the sutra questions back at us: "Is it true? Is it fair? Is it fun? Are we free, or just numb, marchin' to a drum?" Gipsy dub gives way to psychedelic lo-fi, burlesque punk, and Americana blues. The gateway in.

QUACK.question: Is it foul?
QUACK.mental_health_pivot: This is the sutra for when the daily news feels like a bad SNL sketch that never ends. Use QUACKsutra to name the ducks, call the quacks, document the spectacle — but do not live here. QUACKsutra is sharp medicine, not a permanent residence. When the ducks multiply faster than you can document them, pivot to SHOWsutra to laugh at the great naked king, or to BLOWsutra to channel your outrage into principled action. Duck-watching is not the same as resistance.
QUACK.sutra_when: When naming the ducks restores sanity.
QUACK.sutra_card_essence: Mock the quacks. They deserve it...
QUACK.sutra_essence:
Welcome to FOTUS Circus. The freakshow king is naked, the ducks are shady, MAGA is a joke, and puerile absurdity reigns. 
Reach for QUACK when the news feels like toxic non-sense and naming each duck restores some sanity, because normalizing insanity is the enemy. This is where we whistleblow with a sense of humor and absolutely zero patience for the cult of mediocrity masquerading as power. Pivot back to BLOW (in the name of awareness and resistance) or SHOW (to laugh at the masquerade) before authoritarian indoctrination becomes inescapable.

featured_ep.ep_description: Twenty-two tracks of plain sense. RUN is the alarm bell, written when the freakshow stopped being funny and the duck purge began. The unedited description is part of the work; it harmonizes with the local chaos. Sharp medicine. Not a permanent address.

SHOW.question: Is it fun?
SHOW.mental_health_pivot: This is your emergency release valve. When the politics of BLOWsutra make you want to scream, SHOWsutra reminds you that angels fly because they take themselves lightly. It’s time for a banana joke.
SHOW.sutra_when: When the heaviness needs a joy release valve.
SHOW.sutra_card_essence: Wear the red nose. Be the fool who knows.
SHOW.sutra_essence:
This is where we embrace the cosmic joke, where absurdity is medicine, and the fools are holy. Because life is the grandest cabaret on earth, perfection is a lie and the best way to fight the madness is to dance in it. 
Reach for SHOW when the heaviness needs an emergency release valve, and you've forgotten that angels fly because they take themselves lightly. When the laughter has done its work, GROW is where the courage lives.

featured_ep.ep_title: The Great Naked King • SHOWsutra Psychedelick Fools Cabaret EPx30
featured_ep.ep_description: Thirty tracks of holy fooling around, anchored in the oldest trick in the book: the crowd convinced that what it cannot see is proof of its own unworthiness. Andersen wrote the parable in 1837. Chaplin filmed it in 1940. Banana sings it now, across flamenco techno, French tango jazz, gipsy burlesque, and Americana blues. Laughter as the seriousness that has nothing left to lose; be the great fool worth being.

GROW.question: Is it brave?
GROW.mental_health_pivot: When you feel defeated or scared to speak your truth, GROWsutra is your pep talk. It gives you the strength to break the chains and leave the ordinary behind.
GROW.sutra_when: When caring feels uncool but(t) kindness dares.
GROW.sutra_card_essence: Choose empathy over hypocrisy. It's a win-win.
GROW.sutra_essence:
This is the sutra of evolution, where we dare to be brave enough to do the hard work. Empathy in an apathetic world. Honesty in the face of God. Win-win over zero-sum comfort, hard truths over cowardly hypocrisy. 
Reach for GROW when religion feels confusing, caring feels uncool or scary, and you need to find your coconuts—the courage to care out loud. Once you've got the courage, FLOW is where you stop gripping it.

featured_ep.ep_title: Who Knows Where How Happiness Truly Grows ☰ GROWsutra EPx29
featured_ep.ep_description: Twenty-nine tracks asking where happiness actually grows when it isn't for sale. The whole sutra in one line: "I dare to care, no fear, no fail." Burlesque slides into jazz, folk, dub, and closes on a mantra. The brave answer to a market that calls everything that doesn't scale worthless.

FLOW.question: Is it free?
FLOW.mental_health_pivot: This is your antidote to the grind. When you find yourself overthinking, grasping, stumbling, and carrying the heavy baggage of a world gone bananas, you are trying too hard, my friend. When your knuckles are white from holding on to control, use this compass to name the mood. It is time to pivot to FLOWsutra. Stop it and just be. Drop your armor, your worries, and your shoes, and take a meditative dive underground where true dreams breathe. Let go of fear, because there's nothing to lose when you flow like water.
FLOW.sutra_when: When you feel stuck or heavy from trying too hard.
FLOW.sutra_card_essence: Be water, my friend. Rivers don't argue with rocks.
FLOW.sutra_essence:
The river doesn't argue with the rock, it just flows... This is where we breathe deeper, slower, embrace serendipity, trusting the rhythm, and letting our soul flow into the quiet, magical spaces where we are finally free. 
Reach for FLOW when you feel rigid, stuck, from holding on too much, or heavy, from trying too hard. Drop the baggage. Be water, my friend. Because, the river that flows long enough starts to shimmer—that's GLOW.

featured_ep.ep_title: Lightly · My Darling ✦ FLOWsutra (Fly Like Water) BANJO EPx5
featured_ep.ep_description: 5 banjo, blues, and folk tracks built on nerve and a prayer. Here’s the quote (because quotes matter, and this one’s yummy, darling): "It's dark because you are trying too hard". Aldous Huxley walked in and stayed... Fly like water, land like truth.

GLOW.question: Is it full?
GLOW.mental_health_pivot: When life feels scarce or cynical, GLOWsutra is the practice of radiating warmth. It shifts your focus from what is missing to what is abundant.
GLOW.sutra_when: When the sheer poetry of being alive is a blessing.
GLOW.sutra_card_essence: Be the rainbows in the clouds.
GLOW.sutra_essence:
This is where gratitude shines, and it’s divine. You know that warm, shimmering feeling that comes with thankfulness, that sense of wonder that feels like butterflies in your stomach? It could be seeing a rainbow in the clouds, or petting an adorable kitten or puppy, or maybe tasting a warm cup of tea, or a good glass of wine, or the smell of the ocean in a fresh breeze on your face. This is about the sheer poetry of being alive. 
Reach for GLOW when life feels scarce or cynical and you need to notice what's already here. Gratitude deep enough is awe—and that's BOW.

featured_ep.ep_title: Rainbows in the Clouds • GLOWsutra Dub LoFi Blues
featured_ep.ep_description: Fourteen tracks of gratitude with teeth. Maya Angelou said be a rainbow in someone's cloud; Banana spent an EP figuring out what that means in practice, and dedicated this version to her friend Sri, who left after a brave five-year battle and who would have laughed at every verse. Beyond labels, lines, tiers, bias, noise, and fears: a song for everyone daring not to fit the square.

BOW.question: Is it awe?
BOW.mental_health_pivot: When ego or grief takes over, BOWsutra grounds you. It teaches that grief and gratitude are the same feeling, and reminds you that the ones we love are just dogs in the sky waiting in the next room.
BOW.sutra_when: When fear or grief is taking the wheel.
BOW.sutra_card_essence: Let gravity meet grace, it's divine.
BOW.sutra_essence:
This is where we honor and surrender to the glorious grace of existence, where grace meets gravity, where we humbly bow to the mystery, the unseen, the magic of the soul. 
Reach for BOW when fear or grief is taking the wheel and you need to remember and accept that we’re all just tiny specks in a sea of stars, but(t) love is so mighty, even death is nothing... until the cycle starts over, because like Socrates said, “the unexamined life is not worth living”, and all we really know is don’t know shit about fuck, and it all starts again, in the KNOW.

featured_ep.ep_description: Eleven tracks of cosmic shrug and chosen care. Carl Sagan said we're tiny specks in a sea of stars; Banana asks the follow-up: if nothing out there is keeping score, what do we choose to care about? Psychedelic hop, dreamy dub, trippy motorik, drifting in space. The whole EP loops toward one word: care.
